# Ingersoll Heating & Cooling

> From its base in Ingersoll, Oxford County, Ingersoll Heating & Cooling serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (519) 485-2371  |  Email: contact@ingersollheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://ingersollheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Ingersoll, Woodstock, Tillsonburg, Norwich, Thamesford, Embro
